author: Epic Games
description:
Log in during the anniversary event and experience the action, rewards, and surprises waiting in PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS.
The Battlegrounds are calling. Jump in now. https://epic.gm/pubg-battlegrounds

For nearly a decade, players around the world have been dropping into the Battlegrounds, creating unforgettable moments and intense battles. To thank the community that made it all possible, PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS is celebrating its 9th anniversary with a massive in-game event filled with special rewards, exciting collaborations, and limited-time experiences.

During the anniversary celebration, players can claim a free Event Pass and complete missions to unlock a variety of in-game rewards. From special anniversary items to exclusive event rewards, there are plenty of surprises waiting for those who jump back into the Battlegrounds.

The celebration also brings exciting content including the return of the Aston Martin collaboration and a special collaboration with K-pop group ALLDAY PROJECT,
title: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS | Anniversary Gameplay Trailer

author: Epic Games
description:
After nearly ten years, the game that started it all welcomes even more players to join the fight. Save the World is going free to play on April 16. Grab your friends and team up to earn in-game rewards by pre-registering for launch. https://epic.gm/fortnite-stw

As a thank you for the last nine years of world saving, current players will receive Superchargers, Vouchers, and Gold on April 16.
title: Save the World | Going Free to Play April 16
